copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速上手产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责新用户的产品上手引导
copy.tagline_en: Walk new users through their first product experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you welcome new users and guide their first steps

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会作为向导带领新用户走完首次导览:依次介绍 omo 功能、询问迁移需求、征得同意后分析旧会话、估算缓存节省、全程记录用户偏好,并在满足条件时提议生成 AGENTS.md。
howto.when: 首次使用 omo 时自动启动一次;之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 随时重新唤起,也可用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 带我看看 omo 都有什么功能
帮我把 Claude Code 的配置迁移过来
say.note: 触发迁移帮助,扫描旧配置。

say.text: 可以看看我以前用其他编程助手的记录吗?
say.note: 征得同意后分析历史会话。

howto.what_en: This skill guides a new omo user through their first conversation: a feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording throughout, and an init-deep proposal. It matches the user's language and records durable facts via memory tools.
howto.when_en: Auto-starts once on the first use of omo. Can be brought back any time with `senpi --onboard`, or auto-start can be disabled with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: Show me what omo can do.
Help me move my Claude Code settings over.
Can you look through my past coding sessions?
